title: Weekday bicycle-share trips in four districts of Alderport
bodyMd: The city of Alderport built protected bicycle lanes in two of its four districts during 2024. Transport researcher Lena Okafor recorded the average number of bicycle-share trips beginning in each district on a weekday, in 2023 and again in 2025, together with the share of the 2025 trips that ended in a district other than the one they began in.

columns.label: Share of 2025 trips ending in another district (%)

data.caption: Average weekday bicycle-share trips beginning in each Alderport district in 2023 and 2025, and the percent of 2025 trips ending elsewhere (Okafor).

accessibilityText: A four-row table of Alderport bicycle-share data. Columns: district; whether protected lanes were added in 2024; weekday trips beginning in the district in 2023; the same for 2025; and the percent of 2025 trips that ended in a different district. Harbour Row, lanes added: 1,420 trips in 2023, 2,310 in 2025, 41 percent ending elsewhere. Millgate, lanes added: 980 in 2023, 1,655 in 2025, 36 percent. Fenwick, no lanes: 1,260 in 2023, 1,340 in 2025, 22 percent. South Quay, no lanes: 1,510 in 2023, 1,455 in 2025, 19 percent.

provenance.notes: Original table written for this item bank. The city, the researcher and every number are invented; the figures were chosen so that the comparisons the questions ask about are unambiguous.
